title: armeria alpina subsp. halleri
intro: Armeria alpina subsp. halleri, commonly known as Alpine Sea Thrift, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It is native to the high mountainous regions of Europe, where it grows in rocky, alpine environments. Alpine Sea Thrift has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, exhibit therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, contributing to its medicinal properties.
